note: VM shapes the owner publishes measurements for. RTMR0 depends on every field (the ACPI tables QEMU generates: dstack-mr machine.rs/acpi.rs) and MRTD's page order on qemu_version, so each shape is its own golden manifest entry and a miner must launch exactly one of them (launch-td.sh). num_verity_volumes counts the weights disks attached after the root disk. CPU and memory sizes are proposals, not measured requirements.
